# PR #2974 PRD acceptance checkpoint — published 79c, acceptance open

The published source is [79c555fc2ac19b55f7cf585ab96480392c30a694](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/commit/79c555fc2ac19b55f7cf585ab96480392c30a694), tree `1bd2af0961603b185119969fe5dfbe24a25528d3`. GitHub's actual PR merge `728ce370f10b23b1b16ea0510d74ea1e9b082c4a` has the same tree. This checkpoint records actual source-qualified observations and the next required work. It does not change the [original PRD](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/a5f3e138e6d874513f98a355880a9ce0f6fda7da/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/originals/PRD.md), promote a task, approve a release or claim complete qualification.

The check-count snapshot is **2026-09-20 03:48:39 UTC**, with separate later Linux step observation. At that snapshot, 186 checks were 148 successful,14 failed,22 skipped and two active. These are check-run counts, not executed-test totals. The prior ed7313 checkpoint and all 105 of its added files remain immutable. The correction successor is pending review and publication; a reviewed draft is not the source used by these hosted jobs.

| Actual 79c observation | Scope and remaining work |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Intel and ARM resident-client suites | Each passed22 tests, including all five new Mac peer-close regressions. These are functional results from the actual same-tree hosted merge. |
| Intel installed smoke | The report has `passed=false` and `qualification_complete=false`. Recovery is the only false SLO gate: p95=1078.915 ms from two samples, above its 1000 ms smoke gate. Keep that failed observation; do not widen thresholds or call smoke full qualification. |
| Python shard61 | Two live-fingerprint cases failed;240 passed. A successor fixture correction needs its own execution. |
| Python shard58 | Imported v3 mutated-ACK case failed;212 passed and29 skipped. Preserve the failure and all skipped cases. |
| Rust validation | Ten gate jobs failed per the parent/recovery audit. The retained representative primary log shows `cargo fmt` differences at the two noncommand-review test assertions, lines200/230. Formatting must be corrected and the selected gates actually run. |
| Linux native wheel | At the check snapshot the job was active. A later step read shows installed SLO, native soak and artifact upload succeeded, with post-job cleanup still active. No terminal-job or original-sampling qualification claim follows from this step observation. |
| Review |46 reviews are COMMENTED, with no approval. Recovery's03:40 review snapshot retains Greptile 4/5 on prior 2433 and one unresolved current-report scope thread. Final-head independent approval remains required. |

Complete logs, checks, source headers and their capture limits are retained in [hosted-observation.json](hosted-observation.json) and the hosted/evidence files. [next-source-state.json](next-source-state.json) distinguishes proposed fixes from published and executed source.

The separately reviewed349-case harness remains **held and unrun**. Its exact metadata rebind preserves all 20 executable helper blobs,21 selected original modules,349 cases/1047 phases/600-second body,97 ordered quality paths,51 type paths and four ownership gates. Its metadata peer does not transfer any prior result to79c or a later source. The earlier actual 9a attempt still has15 commands,14 passes, one 32-error type failure and zero admitted body cases; all failures remain nested in the retained owner. See [the independent peer receipt](evidence/final349-independent-peer.json).

The full original program remains144 tasks and119 catalog records. Archived statuses74 DONE/31 OPEN/29 BLOCKED/10 DEFERRED are retained without promotion;33 DONE tasks have unresolved direct predecessors and all 74 unresolved transitive predecessors. RSP-100 remains OPEN: categories/signals must be computed once for unchanged exact inputs and recomputed after authority/catalog/input changes. Production remains on its existing path, the experimental optimization is inactive, and a failed pilot is not permission to erase or defer this functional obligation.

Qualification uses release builds and installed artifacts on declared **Linux x64, macOS x64, macOS arm64 and Windows x64** hardware. Record CPU, cores, RAM, power mode, OS, interpreter/compiler, build flags, package/native/corpus digests and background load. Compare matching baseline/candidate artifacts on the same host in alternating order. The original audited baseline is `2e672d2d950c6ec471005ddba46e49bba16dc23b`; new Python-to-Rust kernels also require the optimized Python comparison. Do not edit frozen baseline bytes or substitute the semantic oracle for the required performance baseline.

| Original qualification item | Unchanged requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Priority warm populations | At least 10,000 timed decisions per priority route and platform across at least five independent runs. |
| Remaining routes | At least 1,000 timed warm decisions per remaining installed route. |
| Cold/recovery/resources | 100 cold starts per priority launcher, 100 recoveries and 30 steady-state resource samples. |
| Installed warm c1 | p95 ≤50 ms and p99 ≤100 ms. |
| Installed c16 | p99 ≤200 ms, zero request errors and correct expected decisions. |
| Native warm c1 | Absolute p95 ≤20 ms after reference repair. |
| Cold native/readiness | Native process p95 ≤150 ms; retain 400 ms adapter-first-request readiness starting after snapshot fixture materialization. Full daemon policy-ready startup is separate. |
| Selected hot-path benefit | At least 30% lower p95 or process-tree CPU/request; no more than 5% regression in the other primary metric. |
| Optional ingress benefit | At least 25% less steady-state process-tree private memory or 30% lower c16 p99, preserving containment and semantics. |
| Saturation/resources | c64 bounded overload under the existing contract; no hangs, leaks, cross-request replies or unbounded allocation. Preserve separate 12% short-load and 50% long-soak observed RSS-growth gates and full process-tree measurements. |

Report all offered, rejected, late, failed, retried, denied, fail-safe and overload outcomes, sample counts and confidence intervals using the documented estimator. Keep route/platform and timing-boundary populations separate. Kernel, native client, daemon ingress, installed launcher, full startup, readiness and instrumented phase times do not substitute for one another. Human approval, remote wait and disk/CPU components need explicit attribution.

Authentication, signatures, peer/executable/source identity, generation, expiry, approval challenge binding, replay protection, exact bytes and final consume/freshness fences remain invariants. The 5 ms MCP fence is unchanged. The stopped F plan, its failures and unattempted cells remain historical. This checkpoint launches no MCP performance campaign and supplies no new profiler or RSP-106 execution credit.


Every unresolved original requirement remains in [TODO-current.md](TODO-current.md) and [task-status-overlay.json](task-status-overlay.json). Complete final source checks, actual installed artifact/route/platform evidence, mixed-load/recovery requirements, independent review and tested rollout/rollback before acceptance.

- macOS Unix sockets can finish reading a committed response after a proven peer close. The flush path now handles the same timeout-setter race. Both require the exact setter error and an independent hangup on the owned descriptor. Writes, request deadlines, response authentication and no-replay behavior remain unchanged.
- Windows storage connections share the existing Win32 gate while recovery retains exclusive admission. The storage partition keeps the live connection facade and migration behavior.
- The SQLite observer retains at most 16 process-resident loader aliases, including failed load attempts, and preserves digest and descriptor checks. Typed adapters describe the existing Python 3.12 runtime contract under the repository’s Python 3.10 static-check target.
- Workspace fixtures use the real receipt migrations. Poststart observations, strict attempt labels, finite publisher-failure state and privacy-safe oracle identities preserve the distinction between diagnostic evidence and qualification.
- The source also retains the reviewed Pi/update partitions, constant-time secret checks, stronger VFS refusal assertions and the corrected 51,000-case decision fixture.

The previous two isolated runs on `a028fcf` both stopped on 32 VFS type errors before executing either selected test population. Their complete collection, diagnostics and cleanup evidence remain preserved; the runtime-guard repair addresses that demonstrated cause.

| Current-source validation | Fixed scope; execution pending |
| --- | --- |
| Affected Python | Original 276 cases, source quality and decision-fixture check |
| Additional Python partition | Original 349 cases; the existing eight-case overlap with the 276 group remains explicit |
| Supplemental Python | Original 479 cases plus 94 distinct incoming/affected cases; all individual deadlines preserved |
| Native and workspace diagnostics | 29 workspace controls, 24 Linux Rust controls, real native receipt/consumer checks and installed workspace diagnostics |

The five macOS-specific regressions require actual macOS execution. Linux control results cannot establish that platform result. The supplemental workflow’s aggregate cap is corrected to 210 minutes before its first execution; the earlier 150-minute drafts were never run.

The [original PRD, TODO, Takeaway and ledger](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/tree/75bb8692b5eaaf6f2e138d5da20402b7d270a9bb/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/originals) preserve all 144 tasks and 119 catalog entries.
